description: Edit or remix an existing image with AI. Powerful for CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: pass a reference photo URL + prompt and the model preserves likeness while changing context (e.g. "turn this person into a firefighter, keep his exact face and hair"). Also works for outpainting, restyling, and general image-to-image edits. The trick is describing what to PRESERVE as well as what to CHANGE. Costs 5 credits. LONG-RUNNING: typically 60-120s. If it runs past ~50s the tool returns immediately with a result id — collect the finished image with createa_check_generation about 30 seconds later. Never blind-retry a long generation; it completes (and bills) server-side.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. grok: exact. gpt-image-2: mapped to the nearest supported size (1:1→1024x1024, 3:4/9:16→1024x1536, 4:3/16:9→1536x1024).

image_url.description: Public URL of the input image (e.g. a CDN URL from a previous generation).

model.description: gpt-image-2 makes faithful edits; grok treats the image as creative reference.

prompt.description: What to do to or around the image, e.g. "reimagine as a renaissance oil painting".

watermark.description: Optional brand watermark (Starter+ plans only). Provide either "text" OR "logo_url". Defaults: bottom-right, 65% opacity, white-on-dark text legible on any background.

logo_url.description: Public URL of a logo image to stamp instead of text.

scale.description: Logo width as a fraction of image width (logo mode).

name: createa_meme_remix
